lines.text: Does a slinky's bottom fall? Not for a while.
lines.phonemes: dˈʌz ɐ slˈɪŋkiz bˈɑːɾəm fˈɔːl? nˌɑːt fɚɹə wˈaɪl.

lines.text: Held by the top, a slinky hangs long and still. Let go. The top drops… and the bottom doesn't move at all.
lines.phonemes: hˈɛld baɪ ðə tˈɑːp, ɐ slˈɪŋki hˈæŋz lˈɔŋ ænd stˈɪl. lˈɛt ɡˈoʊ. ðə tˈɑːp dɹˈɑːps… ænd ðə bˈɑːɾəm dˈʌzənt mˈuːv æɾ ˈɔːl.

lines.text: Slowed down, the top coils pile up from above, while the bottom floats there. For about three tenths of a second.
lines.phonemes: slˈoʊd dˈaʊn, ðə tˈɑːp kˈɔɪlz pˈaɪl ˌʌp fɹʌm əbˈʌv, wˌaɪl ðə bˈɑːɾəm flˈoʊts ðˈɛɹ. fɔːɹ ɐbˌaʊt θɹˈiː tˈɛnθs əvə sˈɛkənd.

lines.text: Why doesn't it fall? Nothing down there has been told. The pull of the spring doesn't jump to the other end; it travels down the coils, like a wave. Until the news arrives, the bottom has no reason to move.
lines.phonemes: wˌaɪ dˈʌzənt ɪt fˈɔːl? nˈʌθɪŋ dˌaʊn ðɛɹ hˈæzbiːn tˈoʊld. ðə pˈʊl ʌvðə spɹˈɪŋ dˈʌzənt dʒˈʌmp tə ðɪ ˈʌðɚɹ ˈɛnd; ɪt tɹˈævəlz dˌaʊn ðə kˈɔɪlz, lˈaɪk ɐ wˈeɪv. ʌntˈɪl ðə nˈuːz ɚɹˈaɪvz, ðə bˈɑːɾəm hɐz nˈoʊ ɹˈiːzən tə mˈuːv.

lines.text: And the middle? It falls the whole time, like a dropped ball. The top rushes down, the bottom waits, and the average is a plain fall.
lines.phonemes: ænd ðə mˈɪdəl? ɪt fˈɔːlz ðə hˈoʊl tˈaɪm, lˈaɪk ɐ dɹˈɑːpt bˈɔːl. ðə tˈɑːp ɹˈʌʃᵻz dˈaʊn, ðə bˈɑːɾəm wˈeɪts, ænd ðɪ ˈævɹɪdʒ ɪz ɐ plˈeɪn fˈɔːl.

lines.text: Measure it: the bottom's ghosts stack in one place for three tenths of a second. Then the top arrives, and they all go together.
lines.phonemes: mˈɛʒɚɹ ɪt: ðə bˈɑːɾəmz ɡˈoʊsts stˈæk ɪn wˈʌn plˈeɪs fɔːɹ θɹˈiː tˈɛnθs əvə sˈɛkənd. ðˈɛn ðə tˈɑːp ɚɹˈaɪvz, ænd ðeɪ ˈɔːl ɡˌoʊ təɡˈɛðɚ.

lines.text: News at one end takes time to reach the other, even through a spring.
lines.phonemes: nˈuːz æt wˈʌn ˈɛnd tˈeɪks tˈaɪm tə ɹˈiːtʃ ðɪ ˈʌðɚ, ˈiːvən θɹuː ɐ spɹˈɪŋ.

lines.text: Next: dry spaghetti, bent until it snaps. It never breaks in two.
lines.phonemes: nˈɛkst: dɹˈaɪ spɐɡˈɛɾi, bˈɛnt ʌntˈɪl ɪt snˈæps. ɪt nˈɛvɚ bɹˈeɪks ɪn tˈuː.
